# tfutils_kubernetes_absent_wait (Resource)

Creates nothing. On destroy, waits until no object of any target is left, where a target is a collection or, with `name`, one object, for example until other modules have deleted the instances of the CRDs that this module installs. A 404 for a target, such as a CRD that is already gone, counts as no object left; a 401 or 403 fails at once. Destroy fails with the remaining objects when the delete timeout passes. Use it as a destroy guard in the module that serves the objects: make it depend on that module's own resources only, and do not set its arguments from them, so that replacing them does not replace the guard.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tfutils_kubernetes_absent_wait" "cert_manager" {
  targets = [
    { api_version = "cert-manager.io/v1", resource = "certificates" },
    { api_version = "cert-manager.io/v1", resource = "issuers" },
  ]

  timeouts {
    delete = "10m"
  }

  provider = tfutils.cluster

  depends_on = [helm_release.cert_manager]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `targets` (Attributes List) Collections or objects to wait for. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--targets))

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) API paths of the targets, joined by commas.

<a id="nestedatt--targets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `targets`

Required:

- `api_version` (String) `apiVersion` of the objects, for example `cert-manager.io/v1`.
- `resource` (String) Plural resource name, for example `certificates`.

Optional:

- `name` (String) Name of one object to wait for, for example `ebs-csi-controller`. Every object of the collection when it is not set.
- `namespace` (String) Namespace to look in. All namespaces when it is not set.


<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
